description: RTA Public Transit Service Ridership is a dataset listed in Howard County open data portal (opendata.howardcountymd.gov), an open data portal (Socrata) of a region, state, county or agency, published or maintained by Howard County. This data shows ridership by month for the three transit services provided by the RTA: fixed route, paratransit, and taxi. The data shows ridership in Howard County, Anne Arundel County, Prince Georges County, the City of Laurel, and Baltimore County. Coverage: Howard County, Maryland. The portal files it under the category Transportation. Its tags are rta, public transit, public transport, paratransit, public transportation. The table has 4 columns. Attribution on the portal: Howard County Office of Transportation. The portal shows 2026-04-28 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, service and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-opendata-howardcountymd-gov-portal.
